metric_definitions.suggested_only_f1: Label-only micro F1; suggested candidates; all gold terms in recall denominator; no status correctness implied.
metric_definitions.status_accuracy: Correct normalized status / found gold labels; missing terms excluded.
metric_definitions.status_mismatches: All wrong found statuses including conflict/other_person; wrong_stated is only the narrow subset.
metric_definitions.exact_notes: All candidate labels and normalized statuses match; excludes age, duration and semantic source validation.
metric_definitions.extras: Both suggested-only and including unclear reported separately.
metric_definitions.age: Only scored when gold_age explicitly annotated.
